name: vscode-plugins
description: Turborepo workspace for the Diff Preview and Commit Tree VS Code extensions.

scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.release:commit-tree:major: pnpm check && pnpm --dir extensions/commit-tree version major --tag-version-prefix=commit-tree-v -m "chore(commit-tree): release v%s"
scripts.release:commit-tree:minor: pnpm check && pnpm --dir extensions/commit-tree version minor --tag-version-prefix=commit-tree-v -m "chore(commit-tree): release v%s"
scripts.release:commit-tree:patch: pnpm check && pnpm --dir extensions/commit-tree version patch --tag-version-prefix=commit-tree-v -m "chore(commit-tree): release v%s"
scripts.release:diff-preview:major: pnpm check && pnpm --dir extensions/diff-preview version major --tag-version-prefix=diff-preview-v -m "chore(diff-preview): release v%s"
scripts.release:diff-preview:minor: pnpm check && pnpm --dir extensions/diff-preview version minor --tag-version-prefix=diff-preview-v -m "chore(diff-preview): release v%s"
scripts.release:diff-preview:patch: pnpm check && pnpm --dir extensions/diff-preview version patch --tag-version-prefix=diff-preview-v -m "chore(diff-preview): release v%s"
